notes.title: Frenzy Islands – Coming Soon!
notes.content:
🏝️🌊 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3577420/Frenzy_Islands/]Frenzy Islands[/url] – Coming Soon! 🌊🔥

The cruise ship may be at the bottom of the ocean, but your adventure is just beginning! 🌴 Five unlucky (or lucky?) survivors—Brandt, Zhe Kai, Basil, Daphne, and Naila—have washed up on the mysterious Frenzy Islands, where survival is key, friendships are tested, and sharks are definitely not your new best friends. 🦈

With the help of their loyal buddies, Rico and Kipu, they’ll have to navigate tropical secrets, win over the friendly Chief Tikitiki, and avoid the side-eyes from the island’s most suspicious shaman, Zoc. Can you keep the castaways safe, well-fed, and maybe even find a way home? Or will island life take a turn for the chaotic? 🍹🔥

🌟 Wishlist Frenzy Islands now and be the first to embark on this wild tropical adventure! 🏝️

notes.title: Invisible Threat - New DLC Now Available!
notes.content:
The battles haven't stopped raging in the kingdom! Invisible Threat contains three new episodes for true tower defense fans. We've spent more time on balancing the levels for Steam players. We've also added new enemies to diversify the game. You'll need to use new tactics to beat them!

[h1]Key Features[/h1]

[b]• Three new episodes[/b]
Wasteland – orcs have hidden amongst sharp and dangerous cliffs.
Fiery Plateau – destroy all the enemies on a burning plateau.
Mystic Valley – defend yourself against mystical creatures in an enchanted forest.

[b]• Four new units[/b], each with its own unique abilities.
Skeleton, Necromancer, Fire Elemental, Nature Elemental.

[b]• Four new achievements.[/b] Unique quests made specially for the new episodes. Challenge yourself with exciting trials!

• The DLC also contains 150 free crystals for store upgrades. You can spend them however you like, since you don't need them to complete the game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/320830
